driver.title: How will the ESC be controlled?
driver.question: Choose before anything can be armed. You can change it later while disarmed.
driver.fcDetected: A flight controller was detected on {{port}}.

nano_pwm.name: Acquisition board (PWM)
nano_pwm.desc: The board generates the ESC signal on pin D9. Throttle and measurements share one clock. Recommended.

mavlink.name: Flight controller (MAVLink)
mavlink.desc: Commands the motor through PX4's actuator test. Tests the real flight stack.

manual.name: Manual
manual.desc: You drive the ESC with a servo tester or radio. The application only measures and records.

driver.experimental: Experimental — not yet validated on hardware

safety.armConfirm: The propeller area is clear and nobody is within reach.
safety.armTareOld: The last tare was {{minutes}} min ago. Consider taring again before arming.
safety.armNoTare: The load cells have not been tared in this session.
safety.armNotCalibrated: At least one load cell uses nominal, uncalibrated values.
safety.failsafeHint: The board cut the throttle. Disarm to reset.

throttle.title: Throttle
throttle.manualOnly: Manual mode: the ESC is not controlled by this application.
throttle.armFirst: Arm the output to command the throttle.

rec.title: Recording
rec.stopConfirm: The file will be closed and saved. This cannot be undone.
rec.stopWhileArmed: The motor output is still ARMED. Stopping the recording does not stop the motor.
rec.setupHint: Saved next to the data as setup.json. Fill in what you know; nothing is mandatory.

lib.title: Recordings
lib.filter: Filter by motor, propeller or note
lib.selectHint: Select a recording to replay it. Tick two or more to compare them.
lib.noCurve: No throttle plateaus were found. Record with a staircase profile to get a curve.

device.needConnection: Connect a board to see and change its configuration.
device.applyProfileInfo: Writes the load cell's nominal scale for its rated capacity. The channel stays marked uncalibrated until a real calibration is done.
device.boardInfo: ESC signal timing, watchdog and limits, stored on the board. Use "Save to board" after changing them, or they are lost on reset.
device.watchdogInfo: Cuts the throttle and enters failsafe if no command arrives from this application for this long while armed.
device.slewInfo: Highest allowed throttle increase per second. 0 disables the limit.
device.ratePinInfo: Board pin wired to the HX711 RATE line, if any. 255 means it isn't wired, so the fixed default rate applies; with RATE wired, the rate below can be switched instead.
device.rateSpsInfo: 10 SPS is quieter and rejects 50/60 Hz mains hum; 80 SPS is needed to resolve steps and ramps.
device.calibrationInfo: Capture the empty fixture first (0 g), then at least two known masses. Keep the bench still while capturing.
device.inverted: The reading falls with load: the channel will be inverted.

settings.safetyInfo: Enforced by this application. The board has its own independent limits too (Device tab); the lower of the two applies.
settings.maxThrustInfo: Cuts the throttle automatically when thrust exceeds this value. Leave empty to disable.
settings.maxTorqueInfo: Cuts the throttle automatically when torque exceeds this value. Leave empty to disable.
settings.uiTimeoutInfo: Disarms automatically if this window stops responding for longer than this.
settings.tareAgeInfo: Warns before arming or recording if the last tare is older than this.

alarm.estop: Emergency stop pressed. Clear it to arm again.
alarm.device_failsafe: The board stopped the motor because it lost contact with the application.
alarm.ui_silent: The window stopped responding while armed. Throttle cut and disarmed.
alarm.thrust_limit: Thrust limit exceeded. Throttle cut and disarmed.
alarm.torque_limit: Torque limit exceeded. Throttle cut and disarmed.
alarm.throttle_rejected: The throttle command failed. Throttle cut.
alarm.driver_error: The throttle link failed. Throttle cut.
alarm.device_defaults: The board started with factory defaults. Calibrate before trusting the values.
alarm.settings_invalid: The settings file could not be read; defaults are in use.

confirm.closeWhileActive: The motor output is armed or a recording is running. Close anyway? The motor will be stopped and the recording saved.
